تستفزون (form X)
# تَسْتَفِزُّونَ (tastafizzūna) /tas.ta.fiz.zuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَفَزَّ (istafazza)
# تُسْتَفَزُّونَ (tustafazzūna) /tus.ta.faz.zuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَفَزَّ (istafazza)
